quests.title: The Gate of Hearthglen
quests.description:
Watch Captain Lena Fischer runs the Pale Watch, the Order's camp at the foot of the road to Hearthglen. Before she sends anyone up that road, she wants them to see it.

She asks you to walk up to Hearthglen's gate and look at the walls, and then come back down without starting anything.
quests.accept_text: Straight up the road north of the camp. You'll see the gate long before you reach it. Don't draw steel, and don't let them get a good look at your face.
quests.turn_in_text:
So now you've seen it. Walls, towers, and a lot of people who'd like to burn you.

I was a police officer in Hamburg, back home. I've raided worse places, but never with a sword.

quests.title: Sentries on the Road
quests.description:
Every Scarlet Sentry on the road below Hearthglen's walls turns back anyone who isn't wearing red. Lately they've started coming down toward the Pale Watch at night.

Lena wants them pushed back up the hill.
quests.accept_text: They stand in pairs along the road and in the fields below the gate. They'll call for help, so don't let one run. Keep it quick and quiet.
quests.turn_in_text:
That'll keep them on their own side of the hill for a while.

Hale used to be a security contractor, back on Earth. He knows what an open flank looks like, and so do I.

quests.title: Crossbows on the Wall
quests.description:
With the sentries gone, Hearthglen's put a Scarlet Crossbowman in every hedge to cover the road. They shot one of Mateo's scouts yesterday from a hedgerow.

Lena wants them cleared out of the fields.
quests.accept_text: They hide in the hedges and the ditches below the walls. Close the distance fast, because a crossbow takes a while to wind and they'll know it. Don't stand still in the open.
quests.turn_in_text:
Mateo's scout is going to live, and the fields are ours to walk again.

I've got something for Rory, if you're heading south.

quests.title: Word from the Watch
quests.description:
Lena has watched Hearthglen's gates for a month, and she's written down everything she's seen. Hale is gathering his people inside the walls, and Lena doesn't think he's planning to defend them.

She wants her report in Rory Callahan's hands at Sorrow Hill.

objectives.label: Bring Lena's report to Flamekeeper Rory Callahan at Sorrow Hill

quests.accept_text: South down the King's Road to Sorrow Hill, by Uther's Tomb. Fly if you can. Give it to Rory and wait while he reads it, because he'll have an answer.
quests.turn_in_text:
Lena's report, in her lovely tidy hand. She writes like she's filling out a form.

Hale's getting ready to march. I knew he would. Tell Lena to hold the Watch, and that I'm coming north.

on_accept.name: Lena's Report
on_accept.description: A thick report in a neat hand, with a sketch of Hearthglen's gate on the back of the last page.

quests.title: A Letter for Brill
quests.description:
The Order keeps a man in Brill, Flamewarden Teodor Novak, who watches the Scarlet Monastery from a window over the inn. Lena wants him to know what Hale is doing in Hearthglen, because if Hale marches, the Monastery will march with him.

She wants her letter carried to Brill.

objectives.label: Bring Lena's letter to Flamewarden Teodor Novak in Brill

quests.accept_text: South to the Bulwark, west through the gate into Tirisfal, and on to Brill. Teodor lodges over the inn. He'll offer you a drink, and you should take it.
quests.turn_in_text:
Lena's writing to me? Then it's bad.

I was a firefighter in Brno, back home, and I know what it looks like when two fires are about to join up. Tell her I'll keep my eyes on the Monastery.

on_accept.name: Lena's Letter
on_accept.description: A short letter sealed with the Pale Flame, addressed to Brill in a tidy hand.

quests.title: Worgs on the Road
quests.description:
Scout Mateo Brandt keeps the Pale Watch's roads open, and the Rotting Worgs have learned that the road is where the food walks. They run in packs and they don't let go.

He wants the packs broken up.
quests.accept_text: They run the roads south and west of the camp, mostly at dusk. Don't fight more than two at once. They'll go for your legs, so keep moving.
quests.turn_in_text:
That's a road I can walk at dusk again.

I taught kids to ride horses outside Rosario, back home. Out here the horses are dead and the dogs want to eat me.

quests.title: Skeletal Wanderers
quests.description:
The Skeletal Wanderers walk the roads with nowhere to go. Mateo thinks they were travellers once, caught on the road when the plague came. They're slow, but there are a lot of them, and they never stop walking.

He wants the roads cleared of them.
quests.accept_text: They wander everywhere, but the roads are where they gather. They'll turn and follow you once they've seen you. Don't let them pin you against a wall.
quests.turn_in_text:
Thank you. I hated watching them walk.

They were going somewhere, once. I suppose we all were.

quests.title: Down to the River
quests.description: Mateo wants a way down to the Thondroril, the river along the east edge of the Plaguelands, so the Watch can fill its barrels without a long walk. He wants someone to find a safe path down to the bank and stand on it.

objectives.label: Find a way down to the Thondroril's bank

quests.accept_text: East from the camp, through the fields and down to the river. Find somewhere on the bank the dead don't use. You'll know it when you see it.
quests.turn_in_text:
That's a good path. We'll put a marker on it and a barrel at the bottom.

Oona's down there most days, fishing. Say hello if you see her.

quests.title: The Blighted Herd
quests.description:
The Blighted Stags run in a herd across the fields north of the camp, and when something spooks them they stampede straight through the Pale Watch. They've flattened the tents twice.

Mateo wants the herd thinned before the third time.
quests.accept_text: They graze in the fields north and east of the camp. Don't stand in front of them when they run. Pick off the ones on the edge of the herd.
quests.turn_in_text:
Our tents are still standing this morning. That's a first this week.

Take one of these. It's the least I can do.

quests.title: Travellers' Keepsakes
quests.description: Mateo thinks the Skeletal Wanderers were travellers caught on the road, and some of them still carry what they had in their pockets. He wants their keepsakes, so the Order can write down what they were and maybe find someone who's still waiting for them.
quests.accept_text: The wanderers walk the roads all around the camp. Some of them still carry something small, a ring or a letter or a toy. Bring me whatever you find, and I'll write it all down.
quests.turn_in_text:
A pipe, a thimble, a child's wooden horse. Every one of these belonged to somebody.

Odile at Sorrow Hill will want these for her book. I'll send them south.

quests.title: Riverbank Ghouls
quests.description:
Field Medic Noah Kowal patches up whoever makes it back to the Pale Watch, and lately that's been people attacked at the river. The Riverbank Ghouls hide in the reeds along the Thondroril and drag people into the water.

Noah wants them cleared out.
quests.accept_text: They lie in the reeds on the Thondroril's banks, east of the camp. They'll come at you from the water. Stay on the high ground and let them come to you.
quests.turn_in_text:
Nobody came in from the river with bites today. That's a good day.

I was a nurse in Winnipeg, back home, and I've never been happier to have nothing to do.

quests.title: Sludge Samples
quests.description:
There's a cauldron at Gahrron's Withering, east of the camp, and Noah says the Cauldron Sludge that crawls out of the cauldron is the plague in its purest form. Noah wants to make a serum, and he needs to start with the real thing.

He wants samples, sealed.
quests.accept_text: The sludges crawl around the cauldron at the Withering. Kill one and scoop what's left into a jar. Keep the lid on tight, and don't breathe it in.
quests.turn_in_text:
This is horrible. Thank you.

If I can make something from this that stops the sickness, every medic on both sides of the sea will want it.

quests.title: The Withering
quests.description: The cauldron at Gahrron's Withering is kept by the Cult. The Withering Cultists stir it and the Withering Ghouls carry the plague out to the fields. Noah wants the cauldron left untended.
quests.accept_text: East of the camp, past the dead orchard. The cultists stand at the cauldron and the ghouls work around it. Kill the cultists first, because they'll heal the rest.
quests.turn_in_text:
The cauldron's cold. That's one less in the Plaguelands.

There's someone in charge out there, though, and he isn't going to stay dead on his own.

quests.title: Gahrron the Withered
quests.description:
Gahrron owned the farm that the Withering is named for. He died there and the Cult raised him to guard their cauldron, and Gahrron the Withered still walks his land, still thinking it's his.

Noah wants him put to rest, so the farm can be burned clean.
quests.accept_text: He walks the Withering, near the cauldron. He's slow, but he's strong, and the sickness comes off him in waves. Take friends, and take something for the nausea.
quests.turn_in_text:
Then the Withering's done. We'll burn it in the morning.

He was a farmer. I keep thinking about that. He just wanted to keep his farm.

quests.title: A Serum for Felwood
quests.description:
Noah's made a serum from the sludge. It doesn't cure anything, but it slows the plague down long enough to get someone to a priest. There's a doctor at the Emerald Sanctuary in Felwood, Dr. Nkechi Adeyemi, who's treating a sickness that sounds a lot like this one.

Noah wants a vial of it in her hands.

objectives.label: Bring Noah's serum to Dr. Nkechi Adeyemi at the Emerald Sanctuary

quests.accept_text: Zeppelin from Tirisfal to Orgrimmar, and then north through Ashenvale to Felwood. The Sanctuary's the clean glade in the middle of it. Keep it out of the sun.
quests.turn_in_text:
A serum, from the Plaguelands? Let me see.

This is clever work. I was an emergency doctor in Lagos, back home, and I'd have been glad of this then. Tell him I'll try it on the felblight, and I'll write.

on_accept.name: Noah's Serum
on_accept.description: A small vial of pale green serum, wrapped in a bandage and labelled in careful capitals.

quests.title: The Inquisitors
quests.description:
Sister Amalie Crane was a priestess in Hearthglen until the Hearthglen Inquisitors started questioning the newcomers. She stood in the room while they did it, and then she walked out and kept walking until she reached the Pale Watch.

She wants the inquisitors stopped.
quests.accept_text: They walk the fields below the walls in pairs, looking for anyone to question. They'll burn you if they can, so don't let them finish a prayer.
quests.turn_in_text:
I knew some of them. I prayed beside some of them.

I won't pretend I'm not glad they're gone. That's something I'll have to make peace with.

quests.title: The Confessions
quests.description:
The Hearthglen Inquisitors carry the confessions they've forced out of people, signed and sealed, so they can be read out before a burning. Amalie wants them.

Every one has a name on it, and she wants those names remembered by someone who isn't going to burn them.
quests.accept_text: The inquisitors keep the confessions in their satchels. Not all of them will have one. Bring me whatever you find, and don't read them, please.
quests.turn_in_text:
Here's Agnieszka Nowak, and Tunde Bello, and Hyun-woo Park, and they didn't even spell them properly.

These people came here from nowhere and we burned them for it. I'll make sure they're remembered.

quests.title: The Book of Names
quests.description: Chaplain Odile Marchand at Sorrow Hill keeps a book of names, everyone the Order knows who died in the Plaguelands. Amalie wants the confessions taken to her, so the people in them go into the book.

objectives.label: Bring the confessions to Chaplain Odile Marchand at Sorrow Hill

quests.accept_text: South to Sorrow Hill, by Uther's Tomb. Odile keeps the chapel there. Tell her they're from me, and that I'm sorry there are so many.
quests.turn_in_text:
These are from Amalie? She was in Hearthglen when these were taken.

I'll write every name in the book tonight. Some of them were from Lyon, you know. I knew one of these streets.

on_accept.name: Bundle of Confessions
on_accept.description: The inquisitors' confessions, tied with a ribbon Amalie took from her own habit.

quests.title: High Inquisitor Faulk
quests.description:
High Inquisitor Faulk runs the inquisition at Hearthglen. Amalie served under him, and she says he's the one who decided the newcomers were the Scourge's agents. He walks the fields himself on feast days, with the Hearthglen Inquisitors at his back.

Amalie wants him gone.
quests.accept_text: He walks the fields below the walls, close to the gate. He's got a temper and a lot of fire, and he heals himself when he's hurt. Bring friends, and bring someone to stop his prayers.
quests.turn_in_text:
Then it's done, and the inquisition's got nobody to lead it.

I keep waiting to feel something. I think maybe I feel lighter.

quests.title: Northridge
quests.description:
Woodwright Jonah Lind builds everything at the Pale Watch, and he'd like to build it out of Hearthglen's timber. The Crusade runs the lumber camp at Northridge in the west, and the Scarlet Lumberjacks and Scarlet Sawyers there cut the best oak in the north.

Jonah wants the camp emptied.
quests.accept_text: Northridge is west of the camp, in the trees. The lumberjacks are in the woods and the sawyers are at the mill. They're working men with axes, so don't underestimate them.
quests.turn_in_text:
That's the camp quiet, then. Now we can see about the wood.

I built houses in Duluth, back home. Long winters, good timber. This place reminds me of it, except for the dead.

quests.title: Woodsman Archers
quests.description:
With the lumberjacks gone, the Crusade's sent the Scarlet Woodsman Archers into Northridge's trees to guard the timber. They're good shots, and they know the woods.

Jonah wants them gone before he sends wagons in.
quests.accept_text: They hide in the trees around the lumber camp. Look up, because they like the high branches. Don't let them pin you down.
quests.turn_in_text:
The woods are clear. My wagons go in tomorrow.

I'll need someone to pick out the good planks before the rest of them burn the lot.

quests.title: Seasoned Oak
quests.description:
The Scarlet Sawyers at Northridge carry the camp's best seasoned planks to the carts, and Jonah wants them. The Pale Watch's palisade is green wood that's started to warp, and seasoned oak won't.

He wants enough to rebuild the gate.
quests.accept_text: The sawyers at the mill carry the planks. Take them off the sawyers before they reach the carts. Look for Hearthglen's stamp, because that's the good stuff.
quests.turn_in_text:
Feel the weight of that. That's proper oak.

The gate will be up by the end of the week. I'd like to meet the man who's been running that camp, though.

quests.title: Foreman Harrow
quests.description: Foreman Harrow runs Northridge for the Crusade, and he's the one who's been sending the archers out. He came back to the camp yesterday with a fresh crew. Jonah wants him gone, so the camp stays empty.
quests.accept_text: He's at the mill in the middle of Northridge. He's a big man with a big axe, and he doesn't like visitors. Take friends with you.
quests.turn_in_text:
That's the end of Northridge for the Crusade.

The camp's ours now. I'll put a crew in there next month and we'll cut our own timber.

quests.title: Saw Blades
quests.description: Jonah can't cut timber without saws, and the Crusade took every saw in the Plaguelands to Northridge. The Scarlet Lumberjacks carry good steel blades, Hearthglen forged, and Jonah wants them.
quests.accept_text: The lumberjacks in the woods at Northridge carry their saws on their backs. Bring me the blades and leave the handles. I'll make my own.
quests.turn_in_text:
These are beautiful blades. Hearthglen's smiths know their business, I'll give them that.

We'll have a proper sawpit at the Watch by the end of the week.

quests.title: Snapjaws on the Thondroril
quests.description:
Oona Byrne fishes the Thondroril for the Pale Watch's supper, and the Thondroril Snapjaws keep taking her catch and her lines. They're big and they're mean and they've got nothing to fear in the river.

She wants them thinned.
quests.accept_text: They sun themselves on the banks of the Thondroril, east of the camp. Watch out for the bite, because they don't let go. Stay out of the water.
quests.turn_in_text:
My lines will last the day now.

I fished out of Galway, back home. The fish here are different, but the patience is the same.

quests.title: Plague Bats
quests.description:
The Plague Bats come out over the Thondroril at dusk and dive at the water, and at Oona. She's sure they carry the plague, and she's tired of fighting them off with a fishing rod.

She wants them gone.
quests.accept_text: They roost in the trees along the river and come out at dusk. They're fast, so don't chase them. Let them come to you.
quests.turn_in_text:
I can fish at dusk again. That's the best time for it.

Thank you. Take one of these, and I'll keep a fish back for you at supper.

quests.title: Antler Hooks
quests.description:
Oona's run out of fishhooks, and there's nowhere to buy them out here. She carves her own from antler, and the Blighted Stags in the fields have antlers that are sound under the grime.

She wants the antlers.
quests.accept_text: The stags graze in the fields north and east of the camp. Bring me the tines, not the whole rack. I'll carve them tonight.
quests.turn_in_text:
These will carve beautifully.

My grandfather taught me this, back home, on the beach at Salthill. I never thought I'd need it.

quests.title: Old Thondroril
quests.description:
There's one snapjaw in the Thondroril that Oona's never been able to drive off. Old Thondroril is older than the plague and bigger than a cart, and the Thondroril Snapjaws follow him like he's their king.

Oona wants him gone, so she can fish the deep pools.
quests.accept_text: He keeps to the deepest pool on the Thondroril, and he comes up when he's hungry. Kill the young ones while you wait. Stay on the bank, because he's stronger in the water.
quests.turn_in_text:
The deep pools are mine now. Look at the size of the fish down there.

You'll eat well at the Pale Watch tonight, and every night after.

quests.title: The Patrol Roster
quests.description:
Clerk Wendel Ashby kept Hearthglen's books until he saw what was being written in them. He knows the Scarlet Sentries carry the week's roster, which tells everyone where to stand on the walls.

He wants a copy, so the Watch knows the walls as well as he used to.
quests.accept_text: The sentries on the road below the gate carry the roster. It's in a leather case at the belt. Bring it back dry, please, because the ink runs.
quests.turn_in_text:
This is in Brother Jessup's hand. I'd know his capitals anywhere.

The newcomers here always ask how I can read the walls from a page. It's just bookkeeping, really.

quests.title: Hearthglen's Hounds
quests.description:
The roster says Hearthglen sends its Scarlet War Hounds out at night to hunt anyone near the walls. Wendel used to feed them. He says they were good dogs once.

He wants them stopped.
quests.accept_text: They hunt the fields below the walls at night, and they hunt in packs. Don't let them circle you. Back up against something and let them come.
quests.turn_in_text:
They were good dogs once. I used to give them the scraps from the kitchen.

That's done, then. Thank you. I'll write it down, because somebody should.

quests.title: The Water Under the Hill
quests.description:
Oona Byrne has fished the Thondroril every day since the Watch made camp, and she says the river's gone wrong. There's water running out of the hill above it that tastes of the grave, and it's coming out of the Weeping Cave.

She wants the Cave Drowned and the Seepwater Shades cleared out of the water.
quests.accept_text: The cave's in the hill on the east side, up above the river. You'll hear it before you see it, because the water never stops running down the walls. Mind your feet in there, it's slick all the way down.
quests.turn_in_text:
The fish'll come back now, give it a week.

There's a cave like that on the coast near Galway, back home. The water ran out of it clean. I never thought I'd miss a cave.

quests.title: The Weeper
quests.description:
Sister Amalie Crane heard Oona's account of the Weeping Cave, and she knows the story behind it. A woman went into the pool at the end of the cave to look for her family after Hearthglen took them for questioning, and she never came out.

Amalie says The Weeper is her, and she's asking you to let her rest.
quests.accept_text: The pool's at the far end of the cave, past both galleries. She'll know you're coming, because she's been waiting for somebody for years. Be gentle if you can, and be quick if you can't.
quests.turn_in_text:
Thank you. I'll write her name in the chapel book, under the ones Hearthglen never wrote down.

I kept quiet in that room for a long time. I'm trying to make up for it, one name at a time.

quests.title: The Hermit's Account
quests.description:
Clerk Wendel Ashby remembers every name in Hearthglen's ledgers, and one of them belonged to a hermit who lived in the cave above the river and paid his tithe in fish. The Crusade stopped taking his fish when the plague came, and he stopped coming down.

Wendel's heard that The Drowned Hermit still keeps his cell in the roof of the Weeping Cave, and that he won't let anyone past.
quests.accept_text: His cell's up through the roof of the upper gallery, about halfway along. He'll have his oar, I expect, because he never went anywhere without it. Close his account for me, would you?
quests.turn_in_text:
Tobias Fenn, paid in perch every quarter for eleven years. I'll mark him settled.

It's a small thing, closing an account properly. Somebody ought to do it for everyone Hearthglen forgot.

quests.title: Supplies from Felwood
quests.description:
Dr. Nkechi Adeyemi has heard from the Order of the Pale Flame that their field medic at the Pale Watch is stitching people up with thread he boils in a pot. She's packed everything the Emerald Sanctuary can spare.

She needs it carried to Field Medic Noah Kowal in the Western Plaguelands.

objectives.label: Bring Dr. Adeyemi's field kit to Field Medic Noah Kowal at the Pale Watch

quests.accept_text: It's a long way, I know. Get yourself to the Eastern Kingdoms, through Tirisfal to the Bulwark, and keep going north. The Pale Watch is at the foot of the road to Hearthglen. Don't let anyone ration the sutures.
quests.turn_in_text:
Real sutures, clean dressings, and a bottle of something I haven't seen since Winnipeg.

Tell Dr. Adeyemi she's saved more people today than I've managed all month. Then come back, because I've got work for you.

on_accept.name: Dr. Adeyemi's Field Kit
on_accept.description: A canvas roll of sutures, dressings and small brown bottles, packed tight and labelled in English.
